authored_by: codex from second independent sign-off failures
claim_scope: Project Meridian subject-aware retrieval and abstention regression after two rejected independent sign-offs; synthetic, not blind, not human gold, and not evidence of real-world recall.
decision_rule: All cases and offsets must pass. Deployment additionally requires a fresh independent verifier to invent and execute unseen answerable and contextual absent-subject probes.

documents.title: Project Meridian Vienna coordination note
documents.body_text: Project Meridian field note. The Harbor Institute acted as the organizing body for the Vienna pilot. Its conveners scheduled the first field exercise for 14 May 1987. Eastbridge Laboratory supplied instruments but did not direct the organizing committee.

documents.title: Vienna demonstration observer correction
documents.body_text: Observer correction for Project Meridian. The Vienna demonstration began on 16 May 1987, not 14 May as stated in the preliminary scheduling note. Harbor Institute provided convening support, while Eastbridge Laboratory led operations at the field site.

documents.title: Project Meridian Lisbon communications brief
documents.body_text: Project Meridian communications staff met in Lisbon during June 1987. The Harbor Institute reviewed press clippings for the Portuguese media campaign. This brief does not concern the Vienna field demonstration.

documents.title: Regional archive administration
documents.body_text: The archive office renewed storage cabinets and travel forms for regional programs. No project costs, funding totals, or procurement budgets were recorded in this note.
